edits.value_json: Pip pressed the paper label onto the button. “There!” he cried. “A grand little sign for a very mysterious button!” His tail made a proud little question mark.

At Ada’s tiny bakery stall, Pip pinned a pepper label to the cinnamon button and puffed proudly. Nia offered her bright berry jam, while Ada hoped her baking would make Nia smile. The pastry waited under its surprising sign, as if wearing a red mustache.
